purpose: MOS2/MOS3 Meyer caps split by vds in weak inversion; a vds ~ 0 FET under a gate ramp completes.

oracle.derivation: ngspice 44.2 and 45 print the same eight values. Their spread over reltol 1e-3, 1e-4, 1e-5, trtol 1 and a 1 ps step cap is 0.26% at 0.1 ns and 0.11% at 1 ns, so rtol is 5e-3 and 3e-3. Before the fix espice stopped at t = 11 ps with TimestepTooSmall (Newton 2-cycling on the vg branch current).
oracle.command: /nix/store/bywwgg84ccx0544z9qrfm4zc4ls30ghd-ngspice-44.2/bin/ngspice -b mos2_mos3_meyer_weak_inversion.sp (ngspice-44.2; ngspice-45 prints the same .meas lines)
